answer: Harberger-tax bond: each identity holds a self-priced 100-credit slot on a jade register, paying 10% tax. An onyx panel may buy any slot at its price: a fake below 100 is bought out and evicted, a high-priced fake pays heavy tax. A signal log lists every tax payment and buyout, exposing clusters. 1,000 fakes pay 10,000 tax per epoch, 100,000 over ten epochs, 100,000 staked, vs 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 10 per epoch, keeping slot and share.
